title: Normalized profile
description: Profiler output reduced to canonical metrics. Raw vendor reports stay archived beside this file and are never parsed by a model.

adapter.description: Which profiler adapter produced this, e.g. ncu, msopprof, null.

transaction_granularity_bytes.description: Granularity behind sectors_per_request on this device.

unavailable.description: Canonical metrics this device or adapter cannot produce. Downstream skills treat them as unknown, never as zero.

raw_report.description: Archive path of the unmodified profiler report.
